title: Conversion Conversation
description: 1 captured save. One original BASIC player; historical bugs remain.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: CONVERSION CONVERSATION
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. Increasing lines; common pointer base 22204; exact end marker/EOF; byte-identical left/right payload
versions.startupSource:
2 CLEAR300
5 CLS
10 REM           CONVERSION
15 T=17
20 PRINT"HELLO, I AM A COMPUTER AND I WOULD LIKE TO TAKE WITH YOU."
30 PRINT
40 PRINT"WHAT WOULD YOU LIKE TO TAKE ABOUT?";
50 LINE INPUT H$
60 R=-999
62 H$=H$+" "
65 RESTORE
70 FOR S=1TOT

attribution.text: Original author and any earlier published source have not been established. Preserved here as recovered cassette material.
